text: How #359's gate reads after its review, refining D-0223. verify.Check refuses, before any tool runs, what the selected function's own source shows the gate can't prove: what the verifier input can't preserve of the function itself, an async function, and a decorator, Pure included, since conformance, which a proof needs beside it, binds only undecorated functions. What depends on the rest of the application, its bindings, its trusted contracts, its production sources and the stand-in it ships, is refused once the session has staged it and selected its dependency image, before any test, conformance, backing test or Nagini runs. A proof Nagini verified that still falls short of an effective guarantee, as one whose assumed contract isn't tested or whose function's conformance failed, is marked unqualified in the report, and receipts call it not qualified and leave it out of the proved count; a receipt also counts no in-place proof whose attempt the report doesn't hold. A result's errors keep none of Nagini's timing lines, so the fingerprint holds no timing.
